invariants: These archive layers are not 164 independent trading strategies.
An anomaly label never proves identity, market, state, quote, capacity or profitability.
Historical and symbolic records retain execution_permission NONE until canonical admission gates pass.
Cross-chain, queue, cooldown and maturity transformations are not local atomic flashloan legs unless the exact same-transaction boundary is proved.
All shared pools/books/ticks/bins/collateral/lender resources are deduplicated.
completion_gates: Every source ID maps to a canonical owner or typed ORPHANED_RESEARCH_ONLY.
Each detector has a falsifiable hypothesis, null/control, required data, negative examples and proof gates.
Each route/hyperedge preserves asset vectors, chain/settlement semantics and shared resource set.
Each lender has fresh capacity, fee, eligibility and repayment evidence before qualification.
No new duplicate graph, solver, registry, ledger, source catalog, capital graph or scheduler.
